title: Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing): Dexamethasone Injection Rate for Outpatient Surgery
content:
Dexamethasone (code J1100 under revenue code 0636), billed on an Outpatient Surgery Account of the Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) and valued for an Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing), carries a rate per counted unit of 0.85 USD on a Commercial PPO Claim, 0.95 USD on a Commercial HMO Claim, and otherwise (a Marketplace Exchange Plan Claim) its charges per counted unit times the payer class's expected allowed percentage. It is valued at its counted units times that rate, never above its charges, its counted units being its billed units, or one when it is billed with charges but no units.

**Basis questions (hypothetical figures)**
- *10 units on a Commercial HMO Claim, charges 20.00?* 10 times 0.95 is 9.50.
- *10 units on a Commercial PPO Claim, charges 20.00?* 10 times 0.85 is 8.50.
- *Charges 6.00 with no units on a Commercial HMO Claim?* One counted unit: 0.95.
